start: A trainer’s page, signed in as the gym owner

user_sees: Sheet 'Edit <name>’s page'
'Photo' with 'Add a photo' (or 'Change photo' and 'Remove photo')
'What they teach' with the example 'Weight loss, strength, yoga' and 'Members and the desk see this. At most 80 letters.'
'Working days' with seven day buttons
'Shift starts', 'Shift ends', 'Second shift starts', 'Second shift ends' (each from 'Not set' and 5:00 am to 11:00 pm in half hours)
'The second shift is optional. With no day ticked, every time can be booked.'
must_not: The saved values missing from the form

steps.action: Type what they teach, tick Monday to Saturday, set 6:00 am to 10:00 am and a second shift 5:00 pm to 9:00 pm, add a photo
user_sees: The new photo in the round preview
must_not: The photo saved before 'Save page' is pressed

user_sees: The button reads 'Saving…'
The sheet closes; note 'Saved <name>’s page.'
The page shows 'Teaches: <words>', the new photo, the two shifts on six days and 'Day off' on Sunday
must_not: The note when the save failed
Hours on a day that was not ticked

start: Other kind: the trainer edits their own page

steps.action: Sign in as a trainer, open your own page, tap 'Edit page', change the hours, tap 'Save page'
user_sees: Note 'Saved <name>’s page.' and the new hours
must_not: 'Edit page' missing on the trainer’s own page

user_sees: No 'Edit page'
must_not: A save of someone else’s page accepted from this login (the server side was not read)

start: Other kind: a trainer whose saved hours differ from day to day

user_sees: The note reads 'Saving sets these same hours on every day you ticked.'
must_not: The usual note, with no warning that the per-day hours will be replaced

steps.action: Change only 'What they teach' and tap 'Save page'
user_sees: Note 'Saved <name>’s page.'; every ticked day now has the same hours
must_not: The different hours replaced with no word before the save

start: Negative: wrong hours, a bad photo, a person who may not edit

steps.action: Tick a day, leave both shifts on 'Not set', tap 'Save page'
user_sees: 'Pick the start and end time of the shift.'
must_not: A working day saved with no hours

steps.action: Set a start but no end on a shift, tap 'Save page'
user_sees: 'Pick the start and end time of each shift.'
must_not: A shift with one end saved

steps.action: Pick a file that is not a usable picture
user_sees: 'This photo could not be used. Pick a JPG or PNG photo.' (or the picture tool’s own reason)
must_not: The old photo removed by the failed pick

steps.action: Type more than 80 letters in 'What they teach' and save
user_sees: The hint 'At most 80 letters.'; the saved words stop at 80 letters (Trainers.tsx:993)
must_not: The words cut with no hint at all
A save refused with a raw error

steps.action: Open a trainer’s page as a desk person who is not that trainer
user_sees: No 'Edit page' button
must_not: An edit sheet reachable by this login

start: State: photo removed, hours cleared, edit dropped

steps.action: Open 'Edit page', tap 'Remove photo', tap 'Save page'
user_sees: The page and the trainer card show initials in place of the photo
must_not: The old photo back after a reload

steps.action: Open 'Edit page', un-tick every day, tap 'Save page'
user_sees: Every day reads 'Working hours not set'; every time can be booked with no outside-hours question
must_not: Every day read as 'Day off' (that would block nothing but says the wrong thing)

user_sees: The sheet closes; the page is unchanged; opening the sheet again shows the saved values
must_not: The dropped changes saved
The dropped photo shown on the page

start: Privacy and promise: a trainer’s photo and words are shown to members and the desk

steps.action: Read the hint under 'What they teach' before saving
user_sees: 'Members and the desk see this. At most 80 letters.'
must_not: A photo or words shown to members with no word about it on the edit sheet

steps.action: Remove the photo and save, then look wherever the photo was shown
user_sees: Initials everywhere
must_not: The removed photo still kept or still shown to members
